sub_fields.label: Navigation
sub_fields.name: navigation
sub_fields.instructions: Disable/Enable the navigation on the carousel.

sub_fields.label: Clients
sub_fields.name: clients
sub_fields.instructions: Choose which clients' logos to display.

sub_fields.label: Stats
sub_fields.name: stats
sub_fields.instructions: Each stat gets its own hexagon. The value counts up from 0 when it scrolls into view.

sub_fields.label: Image
sub_fields.name: icon
sub_fields.instructions: Falls back to a placeholder if empty.

sub_fields.label: Text Position
sub_fields.name: text_position
sub_fields.instructions: Show the value/label above or below the image - one or the other, not both.

sub_fields.label: Value
sub_fields.name: value
sub_fields.instructions: The number to count up to, e.g. 500.

sub_fields.label: Use Comma Separators
sub_fields.name: use_commas
sub_fields.instructions: e.g. 60000 becomes 60,000

sub_fields.label: View all Link
sub_fields.name: view_all_link
sub_fields.instructions: Leave blank to disable.

sub_fields.label: Number of Queries
sub_fields.name: number_of_queries
sub_fields.instructions: Enter the number of queries. -1 = infinite.

sub_fields.label: Text
sub_fields.name: text
sub_fields.instructions: This sticks to the top of the screen while the boxes on the right scroll past.

sub_fields.label: Width
sub_fields.name: width
sub_fields.instructions: Column span out of 10.

sub_fields.label: Background Colour
sub_fields.name: background_colour
sub_fields.instructions: "None" uses the row's own background (transparent column). Otherwise gives this column its own coloured panel, text colour adjusts automatically.

sub_fields.label: Border
sub_fields.name: border
sub_fields.instructions: Adds a subtle rounded outline around the column, not a coloured panel.

sub_fields.label: Force Stack Buttons
sub_fields.name: force_stack
sub_fields.instructions: Stack every button in this column's button group on its own line.

sub_fields.label: Text
sub_fields.name: text
sub_fields.instructions: Optional intro shown above the grid (e.g. "Our Advantages").

sub_fields.label: Layout
sub_fields.name: layout
sub_fields.instructions: Layout 1: contained white card, centred items, plain small icons ("Our Advantages"). Layout 2: centred items with a circular icon frame, no card ("Applications").

sub_fields.label: Text (above image)
sub_fields.name: text_top
sub_fields.instructions: Optional - shown above the icon (layout 2's "title above image" style). Leave blank to keep the icon first, as in layout 1.

sub_fields.label: Background Colour
sub_fields.name: background_colour
sub_fields.instructions: "None" uses the card's default navy background. Otherwise gives this card its own coloured panel, text colour adjusts automatically.

sub_fields.label: Link
sub_fields.name: link
sub_fields.instructions: Makes the whole card clickable. Leave empty for a non-interactive card (e.g. if only the buttons below should be clickable) - the buttons stay independently clickable either way.

sub_fields.label: Title
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: Use bold to highlight words.

sub_fields.label: Title
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: Bold text is highlighted pink, e.g. "Our latest updates on...".

sub_fields.label: Buttons
sub_fields.name: button_group
sub_fields.instructions: "View All Blog Posts" etc - shown anchored to the right of the title.

sub_fields.label: Force Stack
sub_fields.name: force_stack
sub_fields.instructions: Stack every button on its own line instead of wrapping in a row.

sub_fields.label: Text
sub_fields.name: text
sub_fields.instructions: Intro above the grid - use the toolbar's paragraph-style dropdown for a heading (e.g. "The Team") instead of a separate eyebrow field.

sub_fields.label: Team Members
sub_fields.name: team_members
sub_fields.instructions: Pick and order which team members show in this block.

sub_fields.label: Force Stack Buttons
sub_fields.name: force_stack
sub_fields.instructions: Stack every button on its own line instead of wrapping in a row.

sub_fields.label: Address
sub_fields.name: address
sub_fields.instructions: The location shown on the map - geocoded to a map pin automatically via OpenStreetMap, no coordinates needed.
sub_fields.default_value: Crown House, 94 Armley Rd, Armley, Leeds LS12 2EJ

sub_fields.label: Title
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: Answer the Question.

sub_fields.label: Text
sub_fields.name: text
sub_fields.instructions: Enter the answer.

sub_fields.label: Before Image
sub_fields.name: before_image
sub_fields.instructions:
Select the before image. This will appear on the left.

Image must ideally be 1920x1080 and under 1mb.

sub_fields.label: After Image
sub_fields.name: after_image
sub_fields.instructions:
Select the after image. This will appear on the left.

Image must ideally be 1920x1080 and under 1mb.

sub_fields.label: Video Ratio
sub_fields.name: video_ratio
sub_fields.instructions: This forces the video into either a 16/9 or 9/16 video ratio.

sub_fields.label: Video Placement
sub_fields.name: video_placement
sub_fields.instructions: Choose which side the video sits on. This also enables a WYSIWYG to side on either side.

sub_fields.label: Video File
sub_fields.name: video_file
sub_fields.instructions: Choose the video file.

sub_fields.label: Video Poster
sub_fields.name: video_poster
sub_fields.instructions: Choose an image to display, instead of the default generated image.

sub_fields.label: Autoplay
sub_fields.name: autoplay
sub_fields.instructions: If true, the audio will be muted. This is a browser limitation.

sub_fields.label: Loop
sub_fields.name: loop
sub_fields.instructions: Loop the video.

sub_fields.label: Muted
sub_fields.name: muted
sub_fields.instructions: Mute the video by default.
